newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jerusalem mayor to face corruption charge--agency.
newsitem.headline: Jerusalem mayor to face corruption charge--agency.

text.p: Israel's attorney-general has decided to indict Jerusalem Mayor Ehud Olmert of the ruling Likud party on corruption charges, the domestic Itim news agency reported on Sunday.

Olmert, one of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's close political allies, is being investigated on allegations he solicited illegal donations for Likud while serving as party treasurer during the 1988 election campaign.
The news agency said the attorney-general would ask legislators to lift the immunity Olmert enjoys as a member of parliament.
Last month, the justice minister in Netanyahu's government resigned after police said they were investigating suspicions he had subornated a witness in his work as a private attorney.
